featured_reviews.name: Alex Mercer
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very good sea food restaurant in Prabhadevi side

Got delighted by some well prepared fish dishes here:
Surmai thali (8.5/10)
Pomfret thali (8.5/10)
Chicken thali (8.5/10)
Paneer crispy (7/10)
Paneer masala (7/10)

Surmai was very large in size and the thali was overall packed with variety
but the fish itself lacked spiciness, it had less salt (which is good)
But felt a little underwhelming due to low spice content.
Same goes for pomfret as well.

Chicken dishes were good but could have had better taste profile.

Paneer dishes were good. But you shouldn't expect anythng great in them since their highlight is in non veg space.

Plenty of space on the opposite footpath for car parking, but it will also depend on luck.

Overall a good 7/10 place.

featured_reviews.name: Asmita Shivalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
🍽️ Delicious and Authentic Malvani Experience at Apla Malvan

I had an amazing time dining at Apla Malvan! The moment I stepped in, I could tell this place takes pride in its food and flavors. The seafood and Malvani dishes were especially memorable — from the fresh fish and prawns to the rich traditional curries, every bite was packed with authentic coastal taste that truly reflects Malvani cuisine. The menu offers a great variety, from classic thalis to delicious fried seafood and homely mains — perfect for both seafood lovers and anyone looking to explore Maharashtrian flavours. The ambience was warm and welcoming, making it great for family meals and casual dining alike. Overall, a fantastic choice for good food that’s flavourful, satisfying, and worth returning to!

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Mavle
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best places in Mumbai for authentic Malvani food!

Visited Nigudkarancho Aapla Malvan, Lower Parel and absolutely loved the experience. The Mutton Exclusive Thali is a must-try — mutton sukka, mutton masala, kheema, tamda–pandhra rassa, alni rassa, crab lollipop, Indrayani rice, wade and solkadhi — everything was flavourful and truly authentic.

The Aapla Malvan Special Fish Thali was equally impressive with fresh fish and perfect coastal masalas.

Special mention to Mr. Ravindra Nigudkar, who has brought the real taste of Malvan to Mumbai — you can feel the passion in every dish.

Plus point: 2-wheeler and 4-wheeler parking available at the Lower Parel branch.
They also have outlets at Lower Parel and Kalachowki, Lalbaug.

Highly recommended for anyone who loves Malvani cuisine. Will definitely visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Bhagyashree varma
featured_reviews.review_text: We had gone for a family lunch at Apla Malvan, lovely setup. We had already informed them in prior that it’ll be a huge group of us coming for lunch, so they managed everything in prior. Servicing was top-notch. We were greeted with smiles. Non-veg thalis are marvelous, everything was delicious and purely made just the Malvan style. So we all truly enjoyed our lunch. Would recommend this to all the Malvan and hard-core non-vegetarian People to give this place a try.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a seafood lover craving authentic Malvani flavors, this restaurant is a must-visit! From the moment I walked in, the warm, coastal-inspired ambiance and welcoming staff set the tone for a memorable meal.

The food was the true highlight—perfectly spiced, fresh, and bursting with traditional Malvani flavors. I tried the chicken thali, solkadhi, and crab thali and many more dishes, and every bite was a delight. The freshness of the seafood paired with their unique blend of spices made it an unforgettable experience.

The service was prompt, and the staff was happy to recommend dishes and explain the preparations, adding to the authenticity. The prices are reasonable for the quality and portion sizes, making it worth every penny.

I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for an authentic Malvani experience. I’ll definitely be coming back for more!

Disappointed Despite the Hype

Almost everyone recommended this place, so I had high expectations—but I was extremely disappointed.

First, we ordered Prawns Koliwada, and it was extremely oily. Then we tried the crab soup, which had a terrible smell 🤮. Thankfully, the staff agreed to cancel that order.

Next, we ordered three thalis—Surmai, Pomfret, and Bombil. Unfortunately, the waiter mixed up the order and included prawns in the Bombil thali. When we pointed it out, he insisted it was our mistake. After some back and forth, he finally replaced it.

But the replacement Bombil was worse—very oily and a strange light yellow color. It was so bad it made me feel nauseous, but since we had already paid, I forced myself to finish it.

Honestly, I expected so much more. I won’t be coming back.

Ordered Surmai thali, prawns koliwada and the famous stuffed bombil. Sadly, the quantity / portion size of dishes has diminished along with the quality. Service was painfully slow on a Sunday afternoon and there were a lot of house flies in the dining area as well. Really concerning health and safety wise. Would not recommend trying this place out with either friend or family for the next 6-8 months atleast.

We ordered bombil fry,  pomfret thali surmai thali, prawns masala, neer dosa and solkadi. Have to mention that I love the fish preparation here as it just melts in your mouth as you relish it's flavours. No extra coating or oil. Neer dosa is perfectly thin. Solkadi tastes fresh and refreshing. However, one thing I would like to highlight is the requirement for a thick masala or gravy to eat the roti/ bhakri in the thali since there is only one rassa given in the thali which goes good with the rice.

Overall a satisfying experience and it's value for money.

featured_reviews.name: Kaivan Doctor
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a very popular Malavni & Kokani cuisine  restaurant  in Lalbaug area.
It is popular for its fresh seafood,Mutton & chicken dishes.
It follows thali system.
Ambiance  is simple & ethnic,comfortable seating,fully air-conditioned . There are two restaurants with different decor but same menu separated bya spectacle shop.
Service is friendly,but sometimes can be very slow as restaurant is full most of the time.Waiters are well dressed & courteous.
Restaurant is very clean & follows good hygiene.
Their menu has a few seafood,Mutton & chicken starters.
Then different varieties  of thalis.
We had specially gone there to have good fresh seafood but found the rates too high as they were as per size.
A Surmai orpomfret thali at around 1000/- however big the fish sounds too high so we had to skip them.
We had a Prawn thali which was tasty with vade & had fried prawns not very big,prawn masala,fish curry,sol kadi,vade & rice for 550/- which was good & tasty.
Also had a Mutton thali with vade for 550/- which was also tasty & worth the price having mutton masala,mutton masala ,sol kadi,vade,rice.
On the whole it was a good meal except for the high pricing of fish items. No rice dishes like biryanis are available  on the menu which is also disappointing.
Can visit with family when in lalbaug area.

featured_reviews.review_text: The food was excellent and fresh fish was served. Their speciality is thali & authentic malvani food. You may have to wait little longer for service. featured_reviews.name: Pooja Uday Parulekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
You should visit Majghar only if you’re genuinely hungry because the portions here are massive! The food is absolutely delicious and satisfying. It’s not exactly pure Malvani or Konkani cuisine, but more of a fusion with Vidarbha-style flavors, which actually makes it stand out. Every dish has a homely yet rich taste that leaves you wanting to try more.
The atmosphere is lively and comfortable perfect for families or groups. The interiors have a simple, rustic charm and the overall vibe makes you feel right at home. What really impressed me was the staff they’re extremely polite, attentive, and always ready to suggest the best dishes based on your taste.
Overall, Majghar is a place that balances great taste, generous portions, and warm service beautifully. Highly recommended if you love traditional Maharashtrian flavours and don’t mind rolling out full and happy!

Good kitchen, but transparency could be much fresher.

From the moment we stepped in, the vibe felt warm and welcoming. The location itself adds to the charm  it’s cozy, calm, and perfect for enjoying a relaxed meal with friends and family. The ambience may not be over the top luxurious, but it has a pleasant and homely touch that makes you feel at ease.

The service here truly deserves appreciation. The staff members are polite, attentive, and quick to respond. They guide you properly through the menu and make sure everything is served fresh and on time. Their friendly attitude adds to the overall dining experience and makes you want to visit again.

Talking about the food, the taste is absolutely yummy and satisfying. Their speciality, pandhara rassa, is a must-try. It has a rich, flavorful, and authentic taste that perfectly complements the meal. We ordered the mutton sukka thali with kombadi wada, and it was delicious. The mutton sukka was well-cooked, tender, and full of traditional spices, while the kombadi wada added a perfect crispy and soft balance to the plate. We also tried the anda thali with chapati, which was simple yet full of flavor and very comforting.

To end the meal on a sweet note, we tried the caramel custard. It was smooth, soft, and perfectly sweet  a delightful dessert to complete the experience.

This wonderful party was sponsored by my friend Aditya Deshmukh, which made the gathering even more special and memorable. Overall, Aanandi  Restaurant offers tasty food, good service, and a cozy atmosphere, making it a great place to enjoy quality time with loved ones.

Mast Malvani – A Hidden Gem in Lalbaug for True Malvani Flavours
📍 Located near Currey Road, Lalbaug, Mumbai

If you’re in search of authentic Malvani cuisine in Mumbai, you’ll know that many places fall short when it comes to delivering real flavors. Ambience & Experience

The restaurant is small, with just about 5 tables, seating around 30-40 guests at a time. Despite the size, their management is top-notch. We were given a wait time but seated within 15 minutes. Every bite screamed authentic Malvani coastal soul food.

One bowl of rich and spicy Malvani Chicken Masala

Another bowl of comforting Malvani chicken gravy

Accompanied with Bhakri, Solkadi, and a signature Malvan-style chutney that stole the show.

The spice, flavor, and balance were spot on.

---

Must-Try: Solkadi

We've had Solkadi across Mumbai, but this one? Truly refreshing, authentic, and soothing. You’ll want seconds.

---

Final Verdict

Whether you're craving a satisfying thali or want to go à la carte, Mast Malvani delivers on all fronts — taste, speed, hospitality, and affordability. It’s no-frills but full-on flavor.

💰 Super pocket-friendly

A Coastal Paradise for Seafood Lovers! 🦀✨
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

If you are looking for authentic Malvani flavors in Mumbai, Malvani Klub is an absolute gem. We visited recently and were blown away by the freshness of the seafood and the richness of their traditional masalas.

The Highlights:

Starters: We started with the Fried Bombil and Prawns Fry. The Bombil (Bombay Duck) was perfectly crisp on the outside and buttery-soft inside—just the way it should be! The prawns were succulent, fresh, and seasoned to perfection.

The Thali Experience:

Surmai Thali: The fish was a generous size, well-marinated, and paired beautifully with the authentic Malvani rassa.

Chicken Komdi Vade Thali: The vade were fluffy and hot, making them the perfect companion to the spicy, flavorful chicken curry.

Crab Thali: A true standout! The crab was meaty and the gravy had that deep, soulful coastal spice kick.

Kolambi Bhaat: This was a revelation! Fragrant rice cooked with juicy prawns and a blend of aromatic spices. It’s a must-order if you want a hearty, one-pot Malvani meal.

Solkadhi: No Malvani meal is complete without this. Their Solkadhi was refreshing, creamy, and had the perfect balance of kokum and garlic to cleanse the palate.

The food here is amazingly awesome and truly authentic. The portions are satisfying, and the taste reminds you of a home-cooked meal in the Konkan belt. Whether you're a hardcore seafood fan or a chicken lover, this place will not disappoint!

Recommendation: Go hungry, and definitely don't miss the Kolambi Bhaat!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dishes we had:
1. Crab Lollipop: 6/10
2. Thalis with Rice Bhakaris
-a. Surmai: 10/10
-b. Pomfret: 9/10
-c. Bombil: 7/10
3. Gulab Jamun: 3/10
4. Fresh Lime Soda: 8/10

Crab Lollipop wasn't great. I have had better elsewhere.
It lacked the basic crab taste and the coating too was very mild on flavor.

The thalis were awesome. The fish were very fresh and tasty that it made our day. Surmai was the best. It had the best flavor, followed by Pomfret and then the Bombil. Surmai and Pomfret were rawa fry with little masala. It was just plain batter fry for the Bombil. We make better Bombil fry at home, so yeah.
The rice bhakari tasted awesome when it was hot.
Dry Prawns/Jhinga/Javla tasted good with the bhakari.
The pomfret fish and curry was very fresh and tasty.
Solkadhi was chilled, felt refreshing and tasted good.

Gulab Jamun was the worst. Hard, dry and low on flavor.

Restaurant is smaller compared to the one near kemps corner. Cleanliness was decent. No washrooms. Only a basin is available. No Queue when we arrived at 8pm. But a queue started building later on.

Group of 4. Saturday Dinner. Mid April 2026.

featured_reviews.name: Prachiti Gadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
During a recent visit to Yazu Pan Asian Supper Kitchen in Lower Parel, I had the opportunity to indulge in a diverse and flavorful spread that truly showcased the restaurant’s mastery over Asian cuisine. From the moment we arrived, the ambiance set the tone for a relaxed yet upscale dining experience. The service was courteous and efficient, with dishes arriving promptly and plated beautifully.

Our meal began with the Prawn Tempura Roll, which was light, crispy, and paired with just the right balance of sauces. It was followed by the Sriracha Chicken that packed a punch of heat, complemented by a slightly sweet undertone. The Yazu Signature Sichuan Garlic Prawn stood out with its bold flavors and perfectly cooked prawns, a definite must-try for seafood lovers. Another highlight was the Yazu Signature Chicken, which offered a rich and savory profile that paired well with the other mains.

For noodles, the Phad Thai Noodles were enjoyable, with a classic tamarind flavor and the right mix of textures. The Chicken in Hot Garlic Sauce added a spicy, garlicky depth to the meal that was satisfying and comforting. We also tried the Shojo, which added a refreshing and slightly lighter touch to the otherwise intense flavor profile of the dishes.

To end on a sweet note, we ordered the Mathilda Cakes Pull Me Up. It was a delightful dessert that offered a decadent and fun experience, perfectly capping off our evening.

Overall, Yazu delivered a memorable culinary experience with a well-rounded menu and elegant atmosphere. It's a great choice for those looking to explore Pan Asian cuisine with a modern twist in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavin Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yazu is a Pan‑Asian “supper club” concept that brings together flavors from Japan, China, Thailand, Korea and Southeast Asia under one roof. The Lower Parel outlet is positioned as a flagship. The place is spacious combining indoor and outdoor elements. The branding emphasizes “visual experiences” — sculptural ceiling installations, patterned concrete flooring, carved wooden walls, lighting as focal décor elements. Ambience is amazing: stylish, atmospheric, good for evenings, date nights, or a premium outing. The décor and lighting get special and the ceiling installation, carved walls, and an aesthetic that’s “Instagram‑worthy.” After sundown, it transforms into a high‑energy bar/music venue  like “Studio Nights”.
Wide and ambitious menu: sushi, sashimi, maki, dim sum, baos (Taiwanese street bun), Teppanyaki, Robata grill items, curries, fusion dishes (e.g. “Asian Pizza‑San”) etc. They offer special dietary menus: Jain and Keto options. Go for signature dishes (e.g. sushi rolls, baos, dim sum) early; save room for dessert.
Top Picks:
• Black crispy Asparagus Roll (sushi) • Steamed Veg. Cheung Fung • Veg. Dimsum Experience Basket (7 piece) • Spicy Lotus root • Mah Poh Tofu etc.
• For soups: the Tom Kha, Tom Yum are superb.
• Desserts are also a highlight: “Pull Me Up Tiramisu”, “Berry Blossom Cheesecake”, “Salted Caramel Tart”, Coconut Panna Cotta etc. Presentation is premium, textures and flavors seem well balanced in many reviews.
• Drinks are highly inventive, globally inspired, and expertly crafted. Every sip is bold and gives unforgettable experience. Loved its Samurai (cocktail), Shojo and Yashi (mocktails) which were flavorful and refreshing.
Attentive and polite staff who guide through the menu, make recommendations, and ensure a comfortable dining experience. Yazu Lower Parel is a strong pick if you're looking for a premium Pan‑Asian dining + bar experience in Mumbai. The ambience, décor, and overall concept are standout features. The place has a premium, elegant vibe and delivers a memorable night out.

The presentation was sublime—every dish was beautifully plated and thoughtfully executed. Highlights included the cream cheese truffle dumplings (the pink ones), hands down the best bite, and the mushroom money bags, crispy with great texture and depth of flavor. The YAZU signature chicken was bold and satisfying, and the wonton soup was light, comforting, and perfectly balanced.

The affogato and cold coffee were an excellent pairing too with the spicy flavors—smooth, rich, and a perfect way to wrap up lunch. A refined yet approachable Pan-Asian spot with fantastic food, strong attention to detail, and great service. Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Amisha Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Having visited countless seafood restaurants across Goa, the Konkan region, and Mumbai, I can confidently say that Jai Hind tops my list.

Yes, there’s almost always a long waiting line, and at times you may be asked to share a table with other diners. But honestly, that’s only because the place is packed with people who keep coming back for the food. And once you taste it, you’ll understand why.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We visited KOKO, Lower Parel, on a completely last-minute plan. Their lunch service goes on till 4:00 pm, with the last order taken at 3:15 pm. Luckily, we managed to reach just in time at 3:10 pm.

We ordered the KOKO Signature Roll (avocado, tempura asparagus, crisps, and KOKO sauce) along with Hong Kong Soy Noodles with chicken.

The sushi was the absolute highlight for me – crisp, fresh, and packed with layers of flavour. Every bite was a delight, and it’s definitely something I would love to come back for. The noodles, on the other hand, had a very balanced and subtle taste, making it a nice complement to the meal.

Overall, it was a great experience. The service was quick even though we ordered at the last moment, and the food quality was impressive. Good going, KOKO – I sincerely hope they continue maintaining these high standards!

featured_reviews.review_text: Where do i begin! Best meal i had in mumbai was at KOKO. The mushroom turnip cake, baby potatoes, signature sushi, the noodles , thai lemonade absolutely fire - 10/10. featured_reviews.name: Dr. Minal Kabra
featured_reviews.review_text:
KOKO, Lower Parel – A Luxe Asian Dining Experience

KOKO in Lower Parel offers a refined and memorable dining experience. The ambiance is top-notch — modern, elegant, and perfect for an evening out. The menu features an impressive variety of sushi and dim sum, with ample vegetarian choices that are just as flavorful and thoughtfully prepared as the non-vegetarian options.

The staff is courteous and attentive, adding to the overall premium feel of the place. However, a heads-up for first-timers — they don’t usually offer tables without a reservation, even if some appear to be vacant. Be prepared to sit at the bar if you walk in without prior booking.

That said, once you’re seated, the food and experience are absolutely worth it. For anyone who appreciates quality Asian cuisine in a sophisticated setting, KOKO is highly recommended — just make sure to reserve in advance!

You can ask the team for some extras like you want dishes without onions or garlic...
All the dishes were flavoured perfectly and with love.

The dessert was a creamy fluffy dream. And the espresso too.
Absolutely all on point.

Price wise it's not cheap. We paid 60 EUR ala cards. They have special brunches like the father's day brunch for 25 EUR plus taxes. These  prices are absolutely fair but eating ala cards is expensive as the portions are not that big.

Nevertheless a fantastic restaurant and we definitely will visit again as the food is incredibly good.

A Hidden Gem for Seafood Lovers!
Stepping into Restaurant was like discovering a true culinary treasure. This charming, intimate seafood restaurant, though small in size, delivers an experience from the moment you walk in, the ambiance wraps around you like a warm, welcoming net. It's cozy and tastefully decorated, creating the perfect setting for a relaxed and enjoyable meal. You can tell a lot of thought went into making the space feel both elegant and comfortable.

The prawns koliwada, bombil fry, chicken lollipop, Surmai fry, PRAWNS biryani & Paneer Biryani, Potato Kappa was cooked to perfection, showcasing the incredible freshness of the ingredients. It's clear they pride themselves on sourcing good quality seafood. The flavors were vibrant, perfectly balanced, and truly unforgettable.
